_comment: Optional: company career pages checked directly, bypassing aggregator lag. To add a company, visit its careers page and see which ATS it redirects to: boards.greenhouse.io/<token>, jobs.lever.co/<token>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<token>, <token>.recruitee.com, apply.workable.com/<token>, or <tenant>.<wdN>.myworkdayjobs.com/<site> for Workday (three parts, not just one token). Bad/renamed entries are skipped silently by the fetcher.
